name: Abu Dhu'ayb al-Hudhali
bio: Khuwaylid ibn Khalid of Hudhayl lived through the coming of Islam and settled in Medina. In 26 AH he joined the expedition to Ifriqiya led by Abd Allah ibn Sa'd ibn Abi Sarh. Al-Zirikli places his death around 27 AH (648 CE) and gives two accounts of its location, Egypt and Ifriqiya. Al-Mufaddal al-Dabbi preserved his elegy for his sons, in which the lives of a wild herd, a bull and two horsemen carry the father's question about the reach of death.
